capability: One-phase Stefan melting with apparent heat capacity

tolerance.rationale: Declared before solve; mushy-width sensitivity is reported separately.

notes: The apparent heat capacity runs at three mushy widths on an 800-cell mesh while preserving explicit latent heat Lf=0.212862645754. Independent quadrature of the Gaussian excess gives 0.212862645754 (relative error 1.9e-13). The corrected two-phase Stefan similarity front for the declared sub-melting initial solid is 0.000850412285 m; the baseline sigma=0.03 front is 0.000852851785 m (0.00287 relative error). All three widths are within the predeclared tolerance.
limitations: The reference assumes equal properties in the semi-infinite two-phase similarity limit; the finite 0.1 m domain and apparent-capacity regularization are tested by the three-width sweep, but no Stefan-number sweep is included.
